question:
The bar graph given below shows the sales of bikes and cars of five companies J, K, L, M and N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6b3969f273973f2c022f57c8b223c57038dab42be26d5011bdb925e025ff1bcf.png] 

P1 = The total sales of bikes of all the 5 companies.

P2 = The total sales of cars of the all 5 companies.

What is the value of (P2 - P1) ?
solution: **Calculation:** P1 = The total sales of bikes of all the 5 companies = 50 + 25 + 125 + 150 + 200 = 550 P2 = The total sales of cars of the all 5 companies = 300 + 75 + 175 + 250 + 200 = 1000 P2 - P1 = 1000 - 550 = 450
